items.text:
🎸🤘 SCHOOL OF ROCK - YOU ROCKED IT! 🤘🎸
FOUR incredible performances and we honestly couldn’t be prouder! 💜💛
To our amazing students and cast - WOW! 🌟 Your hard work, energy, commitment and talent absolutely shone on that stage. Watching you grow throughout rehearsals and then smash all four performances was something very special.
A HUGE thank you to our production team, adult actors and wonderful chaperones who worked tirelessly behind the scenes. From building the set to keeping our children safe, we simply couldn’t do it without you. 🥰
And to our fantastic audiences - THANK YOU! The support and atmosphere across all four shows was incredible, with our Saturday matinee almost completely SOLD OUT! 🎭
It takes a whole team to create something like this…
💜 WE ARE THE MAJESTIC FAMILY! 💜
Enjoy the rest of your summer, everyone. We’ll see you in September because… the next show is already in the planning! 👀🎭
🎸 Four shows. One incredible cast. One amazing team.
SCHOOL OF ROCK - YOU ABSOLUTELY ROCKED IT! 🤘💜

#PerformingArtsSchool #Majesticacademy #MusicalTheatre #ActingSchool #DanceSchool

🌿 NEW JUNIOR CLASSES! 🌿
We’re so excited to be launching our brand-new Elms Creatives Junior Classes this September! 

Designed for ages 6–11, our weekly Tuesday sessions will give young performers the chance to develop their skills in:

- Dance

- Singing

- Acting

- Musical Theatre

From building confidence to discovering a love for performing, there’s something for every budding star! ⭐

Starting Tuesday 8th September 2026

4:00–7:00pm

📍Waterloo Community Centre, Liverpool

Spaces are limited, so don’t miss out on your child’s chance to 

INSPIRE • CREATE • PERFORM 🌿

📩 Get in touch to find out more or secure your place!

DM us or email: info@elmscreatives.co.uk

**WARSZAWA**

**17 - 18 - 19 sierpnia **

**Stawki: 170 zł gotówką **

**STATYŚCI KONTYNUACYJNI**

** **

Do serialu fabularnego **KB** szukam **MĘŻCZYZN ok. 20-40 lat **jako** Pizzermana i Barmana** oraz **KOBIETĘ ok. 18-25 lat** jako **Kelnerkę**.

Dni zdjęciowe dla wszystkich jak w nagłówku.

Dni zdjęciowe dla KELNERKI do potwierdzenia jeszcze 20 i 21 sierpnia.

**Płatność gotówką ostatniego dnia kontynuacji.**

 

Zgłoszenia poproszę na adres: **ewelina.wika@podtytulem.pl**

W tytule: **KB KONT**

W treści: imię i nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, miejscowość

W załączniku: **aktualne** **zdjęcie twarzy (selfie najlepiej) i sylwetki**

** **

**ZDJĘCIE TWARZY** - portretowe selfie w dziennym świetle, na wprost, patrząc w obiektyw. Bez żadnych filtrów. Bez okularów. Bez nakrycia głowy. Kolorowe.

**ZDJĘCIE SYLWETKI** – aktualne, cała sylwetka. Bez osób towarzyszących.

I am very expressive and love campy films but can do contemporary as well.

VOR DER KAMERA BUCHBAR. HINTER DER KAMERA ERFAHREN.

Dieses Foto steht für einen Teil meiner Arbeit, den ich aktuell gezielt weiter ausbaue: Christian Weiße als Schauspieler und Darsteller für Film, Fernsehen, Werbung und digitale Produktionen.

Die Aufnahme entstand im Zusammenhang mit meinem Einsatz für die Sat.1-Produktion NOTRUF. In der Folge „Junger Mopedfahrer crasht in Pkw“ spiele ich den Autofahrer, der unmittelbar am Unfallgeschehen beteiligt ist. Eine Rolle, bei der nicht große Gesten zählen, sondern glaubwürdige Reaktionen, Timing und präzises Zusammenspiel mit Kamera und Regie.

Genau dafür möchte ich mich auch initiativ für neue Produktionen empfehlen.

Ich bringe inzwischen Erfahrung aus zahlreichen Film-, TV- und Streamingproduktionen mit, darunter Alles was zählt, Unter Uns, SOKO Köln, ZDF heute-show, Tatort, Die Füchsin, Identitti, About us / Afterglow und NOTRUF.

Was mich zusätzlich auszeichnet: Ich kenne Filmproduktion aus beiden Perspektiven. Seit über 17 Jahren realisiere ich selbst Film-, Video- und Contentproduktionen. Dadurch verstehe ich nicht nur meine Rolle, sondern auch Kameraachsen, Anschlüsse, Timing, Bildwirkung, Regieanforderungen und die Abläufe eines Drehtags. Meine berufliche Erfahrung umfasst dabei Produktion, Kamera, Regie, Schnitt, Postproduktion, Storytelling und Social Media.

Christian Weiße Spielalter: 38-48
Wohnort: Köln
Größe: 176 cm
Augen: blau-grün
Haare: dunkelblond, kurz
Brille: auch ohne Brille spielbar

Ich stehe für eine ruhige, glaubwürdige und vertrauenswürdige Präsenz vor der Kamera, arbeite konzentriert, zuverlässig und regiesicher und kann mich schnell auf unterschiedliche Rollenbilder und Produktionsbedingungen einstellen.

Gesucht werden Darsteller für Eure nächste Produktion?

Dann denkt mich gern für Schauspiel, Kleindarstellung, Rollen mit und ohne Text, Werbung, Imagefilm, TV, Streaming, Social Ads, UGC und weitere Bewegtbildformate mit.

Stand heute bin ich für neue Projekte und Drehanfragen offen und kann mich auch für auswärtige Produktionen projektbezogen organisieren.

Casting- und Produktionsanfragen:

topComments.text: Lieber Christian, ich würde Dir raten eine klare, eigene Internetpräsenz zu erstellen und dort UNBEDINGT Videos von Deinen bisherigen Projekten hochzuladen. Und auch hier: Weniger ist mehr!  Es ist immer die "Qual der Wahl" WAS man nun in´s Demo setzt, aber Caster lesen sich nicht A4 Seiten lange Texte durch oder suchen Ewigkeiten nach Filmmaterial. Kurze Takes mit möglichst vielseitigen Spielstilen / Figuren. In Deinem Fall kommt noch hinzu, dass es viele Kollegen mit gleichem Namen gibt - was zusätzlich für Irritation / Verwechslung sorgen könnte. Toi Toi Toi !!! für Deine Ambitionen! :-)

LOOKING FOR A CAST FOR MY HORROR FILM “AT THE NIGHTMARES EDGE” 

Here are some of the roles that need to be cast.

Jules Riley- a young adult 17-19 who is strong-willed, stubborn, emotionally guarded, and often the voice of reason in the group.

Deputy Mike Duncan — A deputy 40-50yrs and major father-figure presence in Jules's life

Sheriff Riley — Jules's father. 40-50yrs - A stubborn, skeptical lawman who refuses to accept the supernatural elements surrounding the Howard murders.

Detective Craven — 50 -60yrs - The group's experienced investigator/photographer. He's fascinated by the Howard mystery and becomes something of a mentor within the investigation.

Charles Howard / The Killer — The masked killer at the center of the story. *Age does not matter as face is covered with mask, must be very tall and bulky*

Evelyn Howard — Charles's mother. 30-40 - A tragic figure whose journal Axel and Jules discover beneath the Howard property. *Flashback scenes*

Brett Wildrick — Axel's brother. 18-20 Brett is murdered by the killer near the beginning of the movie, making Axel's pursuit of Charles deeply personal.

Ozzy - 18-20 Brett’s best friend who is a rebellious punk type

Chrissy - 18-20 Brett’s Girlfriend who is the voice of reason of that first group

Young Axel- 12-14 The flashbacks of the main character, young rebellious boy who is still mourning the loss of his parents.

Alice Cross — 17-19 Jules's best friend and one of Charles's victims. Flirtatious and ditzy 

Seth Cunningham — 18-20 Another victim whose death is investigated alongside Alice's. Very cocky and arrogant 

Young Charles *flashbacks* 8-10yrs - a young boy who is subject to a paranormal encounter that changes him forever.

ACTORS ARE GUARANTEED THE FOLLOWING

- 1 copy of the finished film on dvd 

- Free catering on set

- IMDB Credit

——————————————

This job is not paid *for now* I hope to get funding to eventually pay the talented people who can bring this project to life. I am currently only funding this as a broke teenager lol, but I hope we can make this a hit!

*Nonunion*

*Shoot dates are undetermined as of right now*

FILMING IN MA & RI

items.text:
ATLANTA CASTING CALL | MALE SPOKESPERSON | TOMORROW, AUGUST 14
Casting a male actor, approximately 40–65, for a commercial content shoot for a local home services company specializing in decks, roofing, windows, and doors.

Shoot Date: Tomorrow, August 14

Call Time: 9:00 AM

Location: Acworth, GA

Rate: $300 for the day

Shoot Length: Should not take longer than 4 hours

Non-Union

We’re looking for someone who naturally reads as an experienced, trustworthy home services business owner. Professional and approachable, but with enough of a construction/job-site look to feel authentic.

The role will include direct-to-camera delivery, scripted commercial dialogue, and walking through an active construction project while speaking on camera.

Strong on-camera presence is important. We want someone who feels credible, confident, and natural rather than overly polished or “commercial.”

The script can be sent today for preparation and memorization. A teleprompter will also be available on set.

WARDROBE

Talent will provide their own wardrobe and should bring 3 contractor/business-owner style options. Think clean, polished, and job-site appropriate.

You can also send photos of your wardrobe options tonight for approval.

USAGE

Content will be used on the company website, social media, and Meta/Facebook/Instagram advertising.

Likeness and content usage are in perpetuity.

TO SUBMIT

Please send:

Current headshot/photos

Reel or relevant on-camera work

Resume/credits

Confirmation that you’re available tomorrow at 9:00 AM in Acworth

A brief note about why you’re a strong fit

Optional self-tape: Send a quick 30–60 second take as the spokesperson for a local general contractor promoting deck rebuilds to Atlanta homeowners. Strong self-tapes will receive priority consideration.

You can submit in the comments or DM me privately if you don’t want your submission posted publicly.

Type: Independent Scripted Web Series
Format: 10 to 15-Min YouTube Episodes
Location: Kensington, London (Home Studio Set)

Overview:
Casting dynamic, high-energy comedic actors for a brand new, narrative-driven 10 to 15-minute YouTube comedy series. The scripts dive deep into the chaotic, funny, and highly relatable realities of modern relationship struggles, dating miscommunications, and urban London living. The production is designed predominantly to reflect, entertain, and resonate with young Black / Afro-Caribbean worldwide.

Each standalone episode tackles modern situational difficulties, requiring expressive Male and Female performers who excel at sharp dialogue delivery, high-tension arguments, physical comedy, and strong facial expressions.

Filming takes place on an intimate home studio set in Kensington. Great opportunity for recurring roles, travel stipend, and narrative showreel footage.

Self-Tape Submissions Close: August 30, 2026. In-Person Chemistry Reads: Kensington London

**Roles in this project**

ACTORS & PERFORMERS

Lead Role

Female, Male, Non-Binary, Trans Female

Age: 18-35

Seeking expressive, high-energy comedic actors to join our rotating cast for a 10 to 15-minute episodic YouTube comedy mini series exploring modern relationship struggles and urban London living. Open to both experienced performers and passionate unrepresented talent—your comedic timing, dialogue delivery, and facial expressions are what matter most. Great opportunity to secure recurring roles and narrative showreel footage.

🎬 VOLUNTEER CASTING CALL | FEMALE ACTRESSES 18–25
I’m looking for female actresses aged 18–25 to volunteer for an upcoming community short-film project.

🎭 Role: Female high-school bullies

📍 Location: Greater Manchester

🎬 Project: Anti-bullying community awareness film

🤝 Volunteer role: Unpaid

The film is being created through a Community Interest Company (CIC) with the aim of raising awareness of bullying and the impact it can have on young people.

The longer-term aim is to make the film available to schools as an awareness tool, helping young people understand the effects of bullying and encouraging conversations around kindness, inclusion, empathy and supporting others.

I’m looking for confident actresses who can portray believable high-school bully characters and are comfortable working as part of a small volunteer cast.

🎭 No professional acting experience is required. If you’re passionate about acting, want to gain experience and would like to be part of a project with a genuine community message, I’d love to hear from you.

📩 Interested? DM me with:

• Your name

• Age

• Location

• A recent photo

• Any acting experience/showreel, if you have one

Please share this post with any actresses who might be interested. ❤️

This is an unpaid volunteer community project created to raise awareness, encourage positive conversations and make a meaningful impact in schools and the wider community. 🎥

items.text:
CASTING NOTICE: TOO MUCH BASIL

Casting two actors for a 10-minute extract from Too Much Basil, a new play, selected for Flat4 Theatre's Freshly Squeezed Scratch Night at St Margaret's House, East London.

ABOUT THE PIECE

East Village, New York, 1990. Hours after their friend Terry dies of AIDS, Bev and Toni sit up in a kitchen full of boxes, sorting through what's left of him before his family arrives.

Funny, intimate and quietly furious, Too Much Basil explores the often overlooked role of lesbians during the AIDS crisis and the women who cared for, loved and buried a generation of gay men.

ROLES

BEV
Female, 40s. Black. New Yorker.

TONI
Female, 40s. New Yorker. Open ethnicity.

Both actors will need to perform with a convincing New York accent.

CONTENT

The piece contains themes and discussion of AIDS, death, grief and homophobia.

DATES

Tech Rehearsal: Saturday 5 September, 10.00–18.00
Daytime Rehearsal: Thursday 10 September, 10.00–16.00
Performance: Thursday 10 September, 17.00–21.30

VENUE

St Margaret's House
21 Old Ford Road
London E2 9PL

FEE

This is an unpaid scratch performance. Any additional rehearsal will be kept to a minimum and arranged around cast availability.

TO APPLY

Please send a recent headshot, CV or Spotlight/profile link, the role you would like to be considered for, and confirmation of availability for the dates above.

Casting is inclusive and performers from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply. Where ethnicity is not specified, the role is open to performers of any ethnicity.

**Audition Notice:**

**"Little Shop of Horrors" presented by First Impressions Theatre**

**Audition Dates**:
* Monday September 7th @ 6:30pm 4942 Fraser street at 33rd
* Wednesday September 9th @ 6:30pm 4942 Fraser Street at 33rd
* Monday September 14th @ 6:30pm in Deep Cove 4360 Gallant Avenue

**Production Rehearsal Start Date: **January 2nd 2027

**Submission email:** ad@firstimpressionstheatre.com  **                                                                                                             **

**Performance Dates:**
* Deep Cove February 18th to March 6th (Wednesdays to Saturdays)
* Chilliwack May 8th 
* Coquitlam May 10-15th

**What to prepare for the audition:**

Auditionees will be asked to bring in one 1-2 minute comedic monologue and one song (audition cut please!) of their own choosing ***not from Little Shop*** that they believe **best showcases their abilities**, additionally, please prepare a cutting from below based on role preference. *****Music will be emailed to you when you submit via email*****

                                                                         

**Skid Row Bars 1-21**

**Be A Dentist, bars 42-69**

**Suddenly Seymour bars 32-56**

**                                                                            **

**Contact name:** Claude Giroux

**Submit to:** ad@firstimpressionstheatre.com

**Phone Number:** 604-328-0721

**Company Website:** www.firstimpressionstheatre.com

**Pay: **Non-union, all actors will receive a stipend 

                                          

**FIT** is committed to diversity and we encourage all artists to submit, and to self identify if they so choose. We welcome submissions from artists with a broad range of backgrounds including, but not limited to race, ethnicity, Indigeneity, gender, gender- identification, sexual orientation, class and physical ability. If there are any barriers (language, disability, or any other considerations) preventing you from submitting, please let us know and we will work with you to overcome them.

**Additional Information:** Little Shop of Horrors Music Direction by Jenaya Barker. Choreographed by Alice Battista. Directed by Claude Giroux. 

**Production Description:** The meek floral assistant Seymour Krelborn stumbles across a new breed of plant he names "Audrey II" - after his coworker crush. This foul-mouthed, R&B-singing carnivore promises unending fame and fortune to the down and out Krelborn as long as he keeps feeding it, BLOOD. Over time, though, Seymour discovers Audrey II's out of this world origins and intent towards global domination!

**Roles we are casting:**

**Audrey: **She has poor self-worth and education, but a sweet and vulnerable demeanour. Must be comfortable in high heels. All Genders and ethnicities welcome.

Age: 25 to 35

Vocal range top: D5 Vocal range bottom: G#3 Strong belter musical theatre/pop vocal intuition.

Must be a good mover.

**Orin Scrivello: **An egotistical dentist with a passion for leather and sadistic tendencies. Audrey's abusive boyfriend, who is targeted by Seymour. All genders and ethnicities welcome

Age: 25 to 50

Vocal range top: G4 Vocal range bottom: G2 Strong Vocal presence, Slick, Radio Announcer stylings.

Must be a good mover.

**Crystal, Ronnette and Chiffon:** are street urchins, acting as the occasional Greek Chorus. Young, hip, and smart, these three...maybe four are sassy and seriously street smart. All genders and ethnicities welcome. 

Age: 15 to 35

Vocal range top: F5 Vocal range bottom: Ab3 Strong harmony/blending abilities, 50’s pop sensibility. Strong Belts!

These three do a lot of dancing and doo-wop movement.

**Accessibility:** All rehearsal and performances spaces at FIT are accessible, by ground level access. Accessible washrooms are located in all spaces. Uneven ground may be present in the walkways up to the entrance doors. Our performances spaces are all accessible, though smaller doorways may prove to be an access barrier for some mobility aids.

From the Hollywood campus where creators and producers keep finding each other, to Canada's first Vertical Film Festival opening doors for emerging filmmakers, this issue is about a business with fewer gates and far more ways in, with the reminder that the craft still decides how far you go.

**SZUKAMY EPIZODYSTÓW WOJ. OPOLSKIE (OKOLICE NYSY)!**

Jesteśmy studentami Szkoły Filmowej w Katowicach. W terminie 01-04.09 w Lasowicach (okolice Nysy) realizujemy nasz film fabularny ''Dom''.

Do zdjęć poszukujemy osób chętnych na krótkie role epizodyczne.

Szukamy mężczyzn w wieku od 40-80 lat do ról:
• **mężczyzna oglądający dom **
• **mężczyzna kupujący fotel**
• **ojciec**

Nie wymagamy żadnego doświadczenia aktorskiego 

Liczy się chęć udziału i dyspozycyjność. Role są pojedyncze i krótkie, a udział zajmie maksymalnie kilka godzin.

Zapewniamy:
• ciepły posiłek
• kawę, herbatę i inne napoje
• miłą atmosferę na planie 

Jeśli jesteś zainteresowany i jesteś z województwa opolskiego, a najlepiej z okolic Nysy, napisz do mnie w wiadomości prywatnej lub na maila: **etiuda.lasowice@gmail.com**

We wiadomości proszę o wysłanie dyspozycyjności na podane dni, zdjęcia z widoczną twarzą oraz wieku. 

Osobą zainteresowanym podeślemy więcej informacji dotyczących poszczególnych ról i terminów.

🎥 Montaż demo aktorskiego z konsultacją 

Potrzebujesz demo aktorskiego, które pokaże Twój talent aktorski i wszechstronność a jednocześnie będzie zgodne z aktualnymi wymogami reżyserów castingu? Chcesz dowiedzieć się jak pobierać materiały i jak tworzyć takie demo samemu w przyszłości w łatwy sposób oraz jak zwiększyć swoje szanse na konkretną role? Jeżeli tak to zapraszam do skorzystania z mojej usługi 🙂 

✅ dokładnie przejrzę Twoje aktorskie materiały, wybiorę najlepsze aktorsko sceny oraz różnorodne pod względem emocji i ról

✅ zmontuję demo zgodnie z aktualnymi wymogami reżyserów castingu uwzględniając również to, które sceny Ty uważasz za najlepsze 

✅ podczas konsultacji opowiem Ci o obecnych standardach montażu i doboru scen, dam dużo cennych rad abyś mogła / mógł w przyszłości montować demo samodzielnie 

✅ gotowe demo dostaniesz ode mnie maksymalnie w 2 dni od wysłania mi swoich materiałów

✅ przystępna cena 💵 szczegóły na priv 

Na zdjęciach załączam jedną z wiadomość od klienta po moim montażu 🔥💪 

Uwaga! Nie zajmuję się pobieraniem materiałów.

Casting Call
Hello everyone!

I’m just about finished developing a short WLW (women-loving-women) film screenplay and am currently moving into the casting/production stage. I’m primarily a writer/director and have very little acting experience myself, so rather than starring in my own film, my team and I are looking for actors who are interested in helping bring this story to life.

I’m looking for aspiring or established actors between the ages of 20–35 of all experience levels who would be willing to entertain the idea of starring in a small, indie independently produced film that may appear at a film festival. At this stage, compensation will be limited, and I want to be completely transparent about that. The primary things I can offer are a finished film for your portfolio, exposure, creative experience, and the opportunity to work with a small team that genuinely cares about a project.

If you’re someone who loves acting, filmmaking, or simply wants to gain experience and be part of something creative, we’d love to hear from you.

The Story: On the way to say goodbye to one of the most important people in her life, a grieving woman unexpectedly meets someone who reminds her that she hasn’t lost her ability to say hello to someone new.

Alternatively*: During a drive, two people learn and explore the meaning of life, both traveling toward the same destination for completely different reasons — one toward an ending, the other toward a beginning.*

We are currently based in USA Central America, so travel may be necessary. We are also locating to LA for a short period of time during shooting. No travel is required there.

We plan to start a GoFundMe/crowdfunding campaign along with the funds we currently have to help cover travel and production-related expenses for selected cast members. However, I want to be upfront that traveling internationally may still be a significant commitment. Though, we are prepared to take the brunt force of the cost! If traveling to the filming location isn’t realistic for you, we completely understand.

The casting process will be almost entirely virtual and will consist of three phases before filming. Actors of all races, ethnicities, backgrounds, and experience levels are encouraged to reach out!

1 Initial Submission

You’ll submit a short acting tape/portfolio to a secure email. This can include: A monologue, An emotional scene, A scene from another project, Or another personal demonstration of your acting ability. The submission should be between 2–7 minutes.

Along with your tape, you’ll also provide your preferences and boundaries regarding what you are and are not comfortable filming. There is no explicit sexual content in this film. There is a brief kiss scene and some implied intimacy between characters, but intimacy itself is not depicted on screen.

2 Character Audition

After the initial submissions are reviewed, selected actors will receive a character breakdown along with approximately 2+ minutes of dialogue/screenplay material.

This stage will give you the opportunity to act specifically as the character you’re auditioning for and show your interpretation of the material. You’ll also have the opportunity to tell us more about yourself, your creative interests, and anything you feel you could bring to the character. I want actors to have room to make the character their own, rather than simply reading exactly what is written on the page.

3 Meet the team

This is where you will meet cast members and crew in a secure videoconference. We will also be upfront about the individuals receiving your work and if you prefer that route you may audition to a crew member LIVE via videoconference. We already have a team working on areas such as: Makeup, Lighting , Sound, Camera etc. You will get to meet them all.

Even if you’re relatively new to acting, please don’t be afraid to reach out. This is an independent project, and I’m much more interested in your ability to connect with the material, collaborate, and bring something genuine to a character than simply how long your résumé is.

PSA: This is a collaborative project. You’ll be working alongside other actors, directors, and crew members, so communication and teamwork are extremely important.

Casting Call
Hello everyone!

I’m just about finished developing a short WLW (women-loving-women) film screenplay and am currently moving into the casting/production stage. I’m primarily a writer/director and have very little acting experience myself, so rather than starring in my own film, my team and I are looking for actors who are interested in helping bring this story to life.

I’m looking for aspiring or established actors between the ages of 20–35 of all experience levels who would be willing to entertain the idea of starring in a small, indie independently produced film that may appear at a film festival. At this stage, compensation will be limited, and I want to be completely transparent about that. The primary things I can offer are a finished film for your portfolio, exposure, creative experience, and the opportunity to work with a small team that genuinely cares about a project.

If you’re someone who loves acting, filmmaking, or simply wants to gain experience and be part of something creative, we’d love to hear from you.

The Story: On the way to say goodbye to one of the most important people in her life, a grieving woman unexpectedly meets someone who reminds her that she hasn’t lost her ability to say hello to someone new.

Alternatively*: During a drive, two people learn and explore the meaning of life, both traveling toward the same destination for completely different reasons — one toward an ending, the other toward a beginning.*

We are currently based in USA Central America, so travel may be necessary. We are also locating to LA for a short period of time during shooting. No travel is required there.

We plan to start a GoFundMe/crowdfunding campaign along with the funds we currently have to help cover travel and production-related expenses for selected cast members. However, I want to be upfront that traveling internationally may still be a significant commitment. Though, we are prepared to take the brunt force of the cost! If traveling to the filming location isn’t realistic for you, we completely understand.

The casting process will be almost entirely virtual and will consist of three phases before filming. Actors of all races, ethnicities, backgrounds, and experience levels are encouraged to reach out!

1 Initial Submission

You’ll submit a short acting tape/portfolio to a secure email. This can include: A monologue, An emotional scene, A scene from another project, Or another personal demonstration of your acting ability. The submission should be between 2–7 minutes.

Along with your tape, you’ll also provide your preferences and boundaries regarding what you are and are not comfortable filming. There is no explicit sexual content in this film. There is a brief kiss scene and some implied intimacy between characters, but intimacy itself is not depicted on screen.

2 Character Audition

After the initial submissions are reviewed, selected actors will receive a character breakdown along with approximately 2+ minutes of dialogue/screenplay material.

This stage will give you the opportunity to act specifically as the character you’re auditioning for and show your interpretation of the material. You’ll also have the opportunity to tell us more about yourself, your creative interests, and anything you feel you could bring to the character. I want actors to have room to make the character their own, rather than simply reading exactly what is written on the page.

3 Meet the team

This is where you will meet cast members and crew in a secure videoconference. We will also be upfront about the individuals receiving your work and if you prefer that route you may audition to a crew member LIVE via videoconference. We already have a team working on areas such as: Makeup, Lighting , Sound, Camera etc. You will get to meet them all.

Even if you’re relatively new to acting, please don’t be afraid to reach out. This is an independent project, and I’m much more interested in your ability to connect with the material, collaborate, and bring something genuine to a character than simply how long your résumé is.

PSA: This is a collaborative project. You’ll be working alongside other actors, directors, and crew members, so communication and teamwork are extremely important.

We’re looking for people who are: Punctual and dependable. Comfortable collaborating with others Creative and willing to experiment. Respectful of boundaries. Open to feedback. Final, Passionate about filmmaking and/or acting!!

We want to create an environment where everyone feels respected, heard, and comfortable being creative**.**

If this sounds like something you’d like to be a part of, PM me or comment with your email! In the Email or PM please include:

A bit about yourself if wanted

Before the Audition, Name the Opportunity
The word “audition” can describe very different experiences.

One notice may offer paid professional work. Another may be a tuition-based training production. A third may be a community show designed primarily for education, experience, and connection. None of these models is automatically better than the others, but families deserve to know which one they are considering.

Before your child prepares a song, monologue, or self-tape, ask four questions:

Is the performer being paid, paying tuition, or volunteering?
Are there additional obligations? Look for ticket sales, costumes, travel, classes, or fundraising.
What is the complete calendar? Include rehearsals, callbacks, tech week, school-day performances, and transportation.
What does the child hope to gain? Training, credits, confidence, community, or income are different goals.
A tuition-based production can provide meaningful instruction. A community show can build confidence and friendships. A paid role can deliver professional experience. Trouble begins when families mistake one model for another or discover the full cost only after the child becomes emotionally invested.

Clarity does not diminish a dream. It helps families choose opportunities that fit their goals, finances, schedule, and young performer’s well-being.

Warm Regards,

Karla Coleman

ATLANTA CASTING CALL | MALE SPOKESPERSON | TOMORROW, AUGUST 14
Casting a male actor, approximately 40–65, for a commercial content shoot for a local home services company specializing in decks, roofing, windows, and doors.

Shoot Date: Tomorrow, August 14

Call Time: 9:00 AM

Location: Acworth, GA

Rate: $300 for the day

Shoot Length: Should not take longer than 4 hours

Non-Union

We’re looking for someone who naturally reads as an experienced, trustworthy home services business owner. Professional and approachable, but with enough of a construction/job-site look to feel authentic.

The role will include direct-to-camera delivery, scripted commercial dialogue, and walking through an active construction project while speaking on camera.

Strong on-camera presence is important. We want someone who feels credible, confident, and natural rather than overly polished or “commercial.”

The script can be sent today for preparation and memorization. A teleprompter will also be available on set.

WARDROBE

Talent will provide their own wardrobe and should bring 3 contractor/business-owner style options. Think clean, polished, and job-site appropriate.

You can also send photos of your wardrobe options tonight for approval.

USAGE

Content will be used on the company website, social media, and Meta/Facebook/Instagram advertising.

Likeness and content usage are in perpetuity.

TO SUBMIT

Please send:

Current headshot/photos

Reel or relevant on-camera work

Resume/credits

Confirmation that you’re available tomorrow at 9:00 AM in Acworth

A brief note about why you’re a strong fit

Optional self-tape: Send a quick 30–60 second take as the spokesperson for a local general contractor promoting deck rebuilds to Atlanta homeowners. Strong self-tapes will receive priority consideration.

You can submit in the comments or DM me privately if you don’t want your submission posted publicly.

The scripts dive deep into the chaotic, funny, and highly relatable realities of modern relationship struggles, dating miscommunications, and urban London living. The production is designed predominantly to reflect, entertain, and resonate with young Black / Afro-Caribbean worldwide.

Each standalone episode tackles modern situational difficulties, requiring expressive Male and Female performers who excel at sharp dialogue delivery, high-tension arguments, physical comedy, and strong facial expressions.

Filming takes place on an intimate home studio set in Kensington. Great opportunity for recurring roles, travel stipend, and narrative showreel footage.

Cześć. Do krótkometrażowego (ok. 10 min.) dramatu psychologicznego "Blask" kręconego na terenie Krakowa poszukujemy dwójki aktorów:

1. Mama głównego bohatera (ok. 35-45 lat) - przyjemny, ciepły wygląd, stosunkowo szczupła [0 innych wymagań fizycznych]

2. Ojciec głównego bohatera (podobny wiek) - niekrótkie włosy, niezadbany zarost, (który aktor będzie w stanie nieco dogolić na potrzebę jednej ze scen), wzrost ok. 180 cm [0 innych wymagań fizycznych]

Jesteśmy niezależną grupą filmową, tworzącą filmy z zamiłowania do kina. Nie dysponujemy dużym budżetem, ale zależy nam na profesjonalnym podejściu do realizacji i stworzeniu filmu, z którego zarówno my, jak i aktorzy będziemy mogli być dumni. Oferujemy przede wszystkim ciekawą, emocjonalną rolę, możliwość zdobycia materiału do portfolio oraz udział w projekcie, który planujemy zgłaszać na polskie i zagraniczne festiwale filmowe.

Przewidujemy również wynagrodzenie za dzień zdjęciowy, którego wysokość ustalimy indywidualnie.

PL (ENG below)

Siemka!

Szukam kilku aktorek do krótkometrażowego eksperymentalnego filmu animowanego. Film

opowiada historię młodej dziewczyny, Sexy, która wyprowadza się na nawiedzone Rondo, gdzie

poznaje ducha Sabiny. Razem budują ,,kontrowersyjną społeczność”.

GDZIE? - Poznań

KIEDY? - sierpień / wrzesień

Scenariusz jest w języku angielskim.

SPOSÓB PRACY - animacja jest zrobiona ze zdjęć, więc każda z aktorek będzie fotografowana

osobna, a następnie oddzielnie nagrywany będzie dubbing.

Produkcja jest oddolna, więc niestety nie mogę zaoferować żadnego wynagrodzenia. Oferuje

natomiast koszty transportu dla osób zainteresowanych współpracą z innych miast w Polsce.

Kontakt - sabinagr99@pm.me

Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/sabina_gryczan/

———————————————————————————-

ENG

Hi!

I’m looking for actresses for my new short, experimental animated film. It tells a story of a young

woman, Sexy. She moves to a haunted Roundabout where she meets Sabina, ,,friendly” ghost.

Together they built a ,,controversial community” .

WHERE? - Poznań, Poland

WHEN? - August / September

Script is in English.

WORK FLOW - animation is made with photos, so each actress will be photographed separately

and then we will record dubbing independently.

This is a grassroots production, so sadly I cannot offer any money. I can only cover travelling costs

for people from different cities in Poland.

Contact - sabinagr99@pm.me

Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/sabina_gryczan/

 Animation style - [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9SXxWmK84WU](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9SXxWmK84WU)

UNPAID COLLABORATION] Auteure Films Seeking Creative Editor for Indie Short Horror this week, August 20-23.
Logline:
When a 25-year-old woman is diagnosed with a rare geriatric illness, her search for comfort in a medical support group uncovers a terrifying connection between her symptoms and a sinister entity from her childhood.
About the Project:
Genre: Horror / Psychological Thriller
Length: 5–10 minutes (Festival/Competition Requirement)
Status: Shot and wrapped. Footage is organized and ready for assembly.
Tone/Style: Inspired by Coralie Fargeat’s provocative, jarring, and visceral style. We want to challenge the audience and force them to question reality and the plague of loneliness and invisibility. 
What We Offer:
IMDb credit.
High-quality footage for your portfolio/reel.
Industry education and networking through a structured short horror competition.
How to Apply:
Please send a link of your reel or portfolio and a brief note about why this concept excites you to auteure.casting@gmail.com

CASTING CALL | TEEN GIRL | COLORADO SPRINGS

Hi! My name is Irene Tucker, and I’m the Creative Studio Producer at Axis, a nonprofit organization here in Colorado Springs. Axis helps parents better understand teen culture, from music and movies to trends and the issues teens are navigating, so they can connect with their teenagers.

We create short films, ads, and YouTube videos, and we’re currently casting for an upcoming marketing shoot.

We’re looking for:

* Teen girl who can portray 15–18 years old
* African American or biracial
* Comfortable on camera
* Acting experience is great, but not required

Shoot Details:

* Location: Colorado Springs
* Date: TBD (Potentially August 21st or August 31st)
* Time commitment: Approximately 12-5pm
* Pay: $300

If you’re interested, please reach out with a recent photo, your age, and any acting experience you may have. We’d love to hear from you! My email is Irene@axis.org

🎥 Montaż demo aktorskiego z konsultacją 

Potrzebujesz demo aktorskiego, które pokaże Twój talent aktorski i wszechstronność a jednocześnie będzie zgodne z aktualnymi wymogami reżyserów castingu? Chcesz dowiedzieć się jak pobierać materiały i jak tworzyć takie demo samemu w przyszłości w łatwy sposób oraz jak zwiększyć swoje szanse na konkretną role? Jeżeli tak to zapraszam do skorzystania z mojej usługi 🙂 

✅ dokładnie przejrzę Twoje aktorskie materiały, wybiorę najlepsze aktorsko sceny oraz różnorodne pod względem emocji i ról

✅ zmontuję demo zgodnie z aktualnymi wymogami reżyserów castingu uwzględniając również to, które sceny Ty uważasz za najlepsze 

✅ podczas konsultacji opowiem Ci o obecnych standardach montażu i doboru scen, dam dużo cennych rad abyś mogła / mógł w przyszłości montować demo samodzielnie 

✅ gotowe demo dostaniesz ode mnie maksymalnie w 2 dni od wysłania mi swoich materiałów

✅ przystępna cena 💵 szczegóły na priv 

Na zdjęciach załączam jedną z wiadomość od klienta po moim montażu 🔥💪 

Uwaga! Nie zajmuję się pobieraniem materiałów.

🎬mentoring aktorski 
🎬nagranie wizytówek w Warszawie
🎬montaż demo aktorskiego zgodnie z aktualnymi wymogami reżyserów obsady

sharedPost.text:
Chcesz zostać aktorką/aktorem albo mieć więcej aktorskiej pracy ale nie wiesz co konkretnie zrobić? 🤔 Jeżeli tak - zapraszam na konsultacje do mnie, nagranie wizytówek i montaż demo aktorskiego! 🎬🤩 Szczegóły w opisie! 

🎥 Mentoring aktorski 

Dla kogo? 

Dla każdego kto chce pracować jako aktor/aktorka na planach zdjęciowych. Zarówno dla tych bez doświadczenia, któryórzy nie wiedzą jak zacząć i co zrobić jak i dla tych co już pierwsze kroki mają za sobą ale chcieliby mieć więcej pracy i potrzebują rady w tym zakresie 🙂 

Na czym polega? 

Spotkanie ze mną 1:1 online, trwające godzinę. Opowiesz mi jakie zlecenia aktorskie Cię interesują - czyli Twój aktorski cel i według tego dobieramy odpowiedni plan działania. Jeżeli masz materiały aktorskie - to je omówimy i powiem co warto byłoby jeszcze do nich dodać lub jak je “podrasować”. Jeżeli nie masz to dowiesz się co i jak masz zrobić żeby je mieć 🙂 Powiem o moich poleceniach agencji aktorskich, jak samodzielnie i łatwo zrobić demo, jak nagrać i co powiedzieć w wizytówkach, jak samodzielnie szukać pracy, jak się wyceniać, na co uważać. I odpowiem na wszystkie inne Twoje pytania. Po spotkaniu otrzymasz ode mnie maila z planem działania i priorytetami do wykonania + materiałami pomocniczymi dot. materiałów aktorskich. 

🎥 Coaching aktorski z wizytówki + nagranie wizytówek w studio 

Na czym polega? 

✅ Tworzę tekst do wizytówek na podstawie informacji o Twoim doświadczeniu, pasjach, zainteresowaniach, który dostajesz przed nagraniem według castingowych wytycznych, który pokaże Twoje największe atuty

✅W studio nagrań nagrywamy 3-4 wizytówki:

🎬 do filmów i seriali 
🎬 do reklam w wersji dłuższej 
🎬 do reklam w wersji krótszej 
🎬 w języku obcym 
Ewentualnie możemy dograć wizytówkę modelingową

CASTING PAID ROLES FOR SEASON 4 OF OUR ACTING COMPETITION AND THE UPCOMING DARK COMEDY / FANTASY SHORT “PENNY & LANA”

Please read the full breakdown in the description below before submitting.

——————————————————

Written by Rob Borrego, EP / Creator

Produced & Directed by Sheilava

Logline:

Two middle-aged female fugitives take a mysterious “de-aging pill” in order to escape the law and have one last wild night as young women with a second chance at redemption.

*NOTE: 

This is a non-union, independent production filming in the Greater Austin Area.

ALL TALENT MUST BE BASED IN THE GREATER AUSTIN AREA — this is an Austin-based acting competition and production.  No lodging, transportation, or travel compensation will be provided.

Select Talent will appear in our dark comedy/fantasy short, as well as 1-5 episodes of Season 4 of our YouTube acting competition consisting of four rounds of a recorded callback audition process. 

To be considered, all talent must be fully available for our in-person pre-screening Callback round on Friday, August 28 (time slots are scheduled between 10:30 AM - 4:00 PM.

Please do not submit if you cannot be available on this date!

——————————————————

YOUNG PENNY - LEAD, EARLY 20s

FEMALE, BLONDE, CAUCASIAN

The planner, the strategist, and the sharper, drier half of “The Bling Queens.”  She produces the de-aging pills and quietly carries the guilt.

$250/day, meals, IMDb credit

Selected Talent must be fully available during the following production dates:  

September 4, 5, 6, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22.  

*Note: we are scheduled to film late evening scenes on 9/18-9/19 and overnights for exterior nighttime scenes on 9/20-9/22.  

Please do not submit if you cannot be fully available for these dates/times!

——————————————————

YOUNG LANA - LEAD, EARLY 20s

FEMALE, BROWN EYES, DARK HAIR, 
MIXED-RACE / CAUCASIAN PRESENTING

Bubbly, impulsive, and fiercely devoted, Lana is the live-it-up counterweight to Penny’s caution. Her lifelong loyalty to Penny is the friendship our story rests on.

$250/day, meals, IMDb credit

Selected Talent must be fully available during the following production dates:  

September 4, 5, 6, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22.  

*Note: we are scheduled to film late evening scenes on 9/18-9/19 and overnights for exterior nighttime scenes on 9/20-9/22.  

Please do not submit if you cannot be fully available for these dates/times!

——————————————————

JAMES — SUPPORTING, EARLY 40s

MALE, BROWN HAIR, BROWN EYES, CAUCASIAN

James is Andrew’s lifelong friend and partner in their yearly ritual of borrowed youth. He is young at heart, lively, impetuous, and incredibly loyal.

$150/day, meal, IMDb credit, needed for 1 day

*Selected Talent will be needed on 9/19 for an overnight exterior shoot starting no earlier than 7pm. 

——————————————————

***SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS***

Send us an email with the subject line: 

YOUR NAME + CHARACTER NAME

Include the following in your email:

- headshots 
- a recent/candid photo (selfies are ok)
- resume, reels, IMDb, and/or links to previous work 

Send to:

callbackscompetition@gmail.com

——————————————————

DEADLINE TO SUBMIT:  
THURSDAY, AUGUST 20th, 12 PM NOON

CASTING CALL: LONDON (KENSINGTON) – RECURRING WEB SITCOM SERIES 

**Project Title:** London Comedy Series
**Format:** Narrative, Scripted 10 to 15-Minute YouTube Episodes
**Production Type:** Independent / Non-Commercial Collaborative Passion Project
**Shooting Schedule:** Batched weekend sessions commencing Mid-September 2026

**Compensation & Perks:**
This is a non-commercial collaborative passion project. Roles are un-salaried, but a **£25 flat-rate travel and expenses stipend** is paid directly on the day of filming to fully cover your London commute. Full on-set catering/refreshments and high-quality, fully-edited digital 4K footage will be provided directly for your professional showreel.

**Key Deadlines:**
* **Self-Tape Audition Deadline:** August 30, 2026
* **In-Person Chemistry Reads (Kensington):** September 15, 2026

**Project Overview:**
Written by a published fiction author, this narrative-driven comedy web series dives deep into the chaotic, funny, and highly relatable realities of modern relationship struggles, dating miscommunications, and urban London living. The production is designed predominantly to reflect, entertain, and resonate with the young Black British community.

We are building a permanent, recurring family/friendship circle across multiple episodes. We are seeking highly expressive London-based performers (**Ages 18–35**, Black / African / Caribbean heritage) who excel at sharp dialogue pacing, intense comedic arguments, physical comedy, and strong facial expressions.

 CHARACTER ROLES (4 FEMALES, 4 MALES)

 FEMALE ROLES:
* ANNIE (Series Lead | 18–35  **| Ethnicity - Black**): *The Grounded Interrogator.* Sharp-witted, highly observant, and possessor of a flawless radar for nonsense. She uses weaponized sarcasm, logic, and deadpan calmness to systematically dismantle her partner's excuses. Exceptional comedic timing required.
* SARAH (Recurring | 18–35  **| All Ethnicities**): *The Audacious Disrupter.* Outspoken, completely confident, and utterly unapologetic about her presence. Her unexpected messages, phone calls, or drop-ins always spark massive friction in the household. High screen energy required.
* BLESSING (Recurring | 18–35  **| All Ethnicities**): *The Loyal Hype-Woman.* Annie’s fiercely protective and highly suspicious best friend. She acts as the ultimate digital detective, uncovering "receipts" and backing Annie up with brutal side-eyes and sharp comedic interruptions.
* TIFE (Recurring | 18–35  **| All Ethnicities**): *The Mischievous Firecracker.* Highly energetic and unpredictable. She thrives on chaos and loves stirring the pot just to see what happens. Outspoken, playful, and filterless, she turns small disagreements into massive explosions.
* **LARISA (Recurring | Female | 22–35 | All Ethnicities):** *The Neutral Truth-Teller.* A close, trusted friend to both Annie and Sam. Mature, level-headed, and a natural voice of reason. When either party comes to her to complain about a relationship struggle, she refuses to take sides. She stays completely neutral, delivers the brutal hard truth to both of them, and guides them to work through their differences. Requires an actress who can balance gentle authority with sharp comedic timing.
* 

 MALE ROLES:
* SAM (Series Lead | 18–35 | **Ethnicity - Black**  ): *The Chaotic Charmer.* Charismatic but chronically guilty of trying to take the easy way out of awkward situations. When caught in a tight spot, his brain short-circuits into over-elaborate gaslighting, frantic physical panic, and rapid-fire speech.
* MARK (Recurring | 18–35 **| All Ethnicities**): *The Accidental Saboteur.* Sam’s closest friend. Laid-back, completely oblivious to social cues, and permanently relaxed. In trying to defend Sam, he casually exposes truths that completely ruin Sam’s cover stories with a relaxed smile.
* BEN (Recurring | 18–35 **| All Ethnicities**): *The Naive Accommodator.* Intensely eager to please everyone and completely non-confrontational. He has a fiercely loyal but utterly non-questioning personality, meaning he will agree with whoever is speaking to avoid awkwardness. Highly manipulated by the group.

**HOW TO APPLY:**
Please send a direct message (DM) specifying which character you'd like to play and we'll DM you the email to send your 60-second smartphone self-tape attached audition script to.
1. Your preferred character role(s)
2. Current Headshot / Spotlight link
3. Your general location in London

LOOKING FOR A CAST FOR MY HORROR FILM “AT THE NIGHTMARES EDGE” 

Here are some of the roles that need to be cast.

Jules Riley- a young adult 17-19 who is strong-willed, stubborn, emotionally guarded, and often the voice of reason in the group.

Deputy Mike Duncan — A deputy 40-50yrs and major father-figure presence in Jules's life

Sheriff Riley — Jules's father. 40-50yrs - A stubborn, skeptical lawman who refuses to accept the supernatural elements surrounding the Howard murders.

Detective Craven — 50 -60yrs - The group's experienced investigator/photographer. He's fascinated by the Howard mystery and becomes something of a mentor within the investigation.

Charles Howard / The Killer — The masked killer at the center of the story. *Age does not matter as face is covered with mask, must be very tall and bulky*

Evelyn Howard — Charles's mother. 30-40 - A tragic figure whose journal Axel and Jules discover beneath the Howard property. *Flashback scenes*

Brett Wildrick — Axel's brother. 18-20 Brett is murdered by the killer near the beginning of the movie, making Axel's pursuit of Charles deeply personal.

Ozzy - 18-20 Brett’s best friend who is a rebellious punk type

Chrissy - 18-20 Brett’s Girlfriend who is the voice of reason of that first group

Young Axel- 12-14 The flashbacks of the main character, young rebellious boy who is still mourning the loss of his parents.

Alice Cross — 17-19 Jules's best friend and one of Charles's victims. Flirtatious and ditzy 

Seth Cunningham — 18-20 Another victim whose death is investigated alongside Alice's. Very cocky and arrogant 

Young Charles *flashbacks* 8-10yrs - a young boy who is subject to a paranormal encounter that changes him forever.

Jules Riley- a young adult 17-19 who is strong-willed, stubborn, emotionally guarded, and often the voice of reason in the group.

Deputy Mike Duncan — A deputy 40-50yrs and major father-figure presence in Jules's life

Sheriff Riley — Jules's father. 40-50yrs - A stubborn, skeptical lawman who refuses to accept the supernatural elements surrounding the Howard murders.

Detective Craven — 50 -60yrs - The group's experienced investigator/photographer. He's fascinated by the Howard mystery and becomes something of a mentor within the investigation.

Charles Howard / The Killer — The masked killer at the center of the story. *Age does not matter as face is covered with mask, must be very tall and bulky*

Evelyn Howard — Charles's mother. 30-40 - A tragic figure whose journal Axel and Jules discover beneath the Howard property. *Flashback scenes*

Brett Wildrick — Axel's brother. 18-20 Brett is murdered by the killer near the beginning of the movie, making Axel's pursuit of Charles deeply personal.

Ozzy - 18-20 Brett’s best friend who is a rebellious punk type

Chrissy - 18-20 Brett’s Girlfriend who is the voice of reason of that first group

Young Axel- 12-14 The flashbacks of the main character, young rebellious boy who is still mourning the loss of his parents.

Alice Cross — 17-19 Jules's best friend and one of Charles's victims. Flirtatious and ditzy 

Seth Cunningham — 18-20 Another victim whose death is investigated alongside Alice's. Very cocky and arrogant 

Young Charles *flashbacks* 8-10yrs - a young boy who is subject to a paranormal encounter that changes him forever.

Mira Tzenov: Wie weit geht sie für ihre Schauspielkarriere? Karrideo TV - Dein Karriere Video 

Mira Tzenov will als Schauspielerin vor die Kamera. Im Interview in Köln erzählt sie von spontanen Castings, ihren Wunschrollen und davon, wie weit sie für ihre Schauspielkarriere gehen würde. 
 
Was passiert, wenn aus dem Traum von der großen Leinwand plötzlich eine echte Chance wird? 
 
Karrideo - Dein Karrierevideo trifft Schauspiel-Newcomerin Mira Tzenov im Rheinauhafen Köln. Direkt am Sommerkino sprechen wir darüber, wie es sich für sie anfühlen würde, eines Tages den eigenen Namen im Vor- oder Abspann eines Kinofilms zu entdecken. 
 
Dabei zeigt Mira Tzenov, wie viel Spontaneität eine Schauspielkarriere verlangen kann. Sonntagabend gegen 21 Uhr kam die Nachricht, dass sie eine weitere Casting-Runde erreicht hatte. Die Frage: Kann sie am nächsten Morgen um 10 Uhr in München sein? Ihre Antwort war klar. Um 4 Uhr morgens ging es von Köln Richtung München. 
 
Im Interview verrät Mira außerdem, welche Rollen sie besonders reizen. Gerade Figuren, die einen starken Kontrast zu ihrer eigenen Persönlichkeit bilden, findet sie spannend. Eine fiese Freundin, eine Diva oder eine Rolle in einer Komödie kann sie sich gut vorstellen. 

Christian Weiße begleitet das Interview als Interviewer, Moderator und Produzent für Karrideo - Dein Karrierevideo. 

Welche Filmrolle würdest Du Mira Tzenov sofort zutrauen? Schreib Deine Idee in die Kommentare.

Mira Tzenov: Wie weit geht sie für ihre Schauspielkarriere? Karrideo TV - Dein Karriere Video 

Mira Tzenov will als Schauspielerin vor die Kamera. Im Interview in Köln erzählt sie von spontanen Castings, ihren Wunschrollen und davon, wie weit sie für ihre Schauspielkarriere gehen würde. 
 
Was passiert, wenn aus dem Traum von der großen Leinwand plötzlich eine echte Chance wird? 
 
Karrideo - Dein Karrierevideo trifft Schauspiel-Newcomerin Mira Tzenov im Rheinauhafen Köln. Direkt am Sommerkino sprechen wir darüber, wie es sich für sie anfühlen würde, eines Tages den eigenen Namen im Vor- oder Abspann eines Kinofilms zu entdecken. 
 
Dabei zeigt Mira Tzenov, wie viel Spontaneität eine Schauspielkarriere verlangen kann. Sonntagabend gegen 21 Uhr kam die Nachricht, dass sie eine weitere Casting-Runde erreicht hatte. Die Frage: Kann sie am nächsten Morgen um 10 Uhr in München sein? Ihre Antwort war klar. Um 4 Uhr morgens ging es von Köln Richtung München. 
 
Im Interview verrät Mira außerdem, welche Rollen sie besonders reizen. Gerade Figuren, die einen starken Kontrast zu ihrer eigenen Persönlichkeit bilden, findet sie spannend. Eine fiese Freundin, eine Diva oder eine Rolle in einer Komödie kann sie sich gut vorstellen. 

Christian Weiße begleitet das Interview als Interviewer, Moderator und Produzent für Karrideo - Dein Karrierevideo. 

Welche Filmrolle würdest Du Mira Tzenov sofort zutrauen? Schreib Deine Idee in die Kommentare.

Hello! I am posting to try and get my next film casted! This is my most ambitus film I believe I have been apart of! This story needs A LOT of characters, so I'm hoping for the interest :) . Here is the casting call for all the characters needed, character descriptions below! Dates are not exactly figured out yet, due to how many people will be needed to finish the project. However, our first shooting date will be August 28th! That day will be Derek and whoever is casted as Bailey!

**🎬 CASTING CALL — “Not My Movie” 🎥**
**Written & Directed by **Jordan Jackson

**We’re casting for a anthology short film project filming in Colorado Springs. A connected series of stories about identity, genre, attention, loneliness, chaos, and trying to figure out where you belong.**

**━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━**

**The tone ranges from:**

·         **awkward comedy**

·         **existential conversations**

·         **thriller/horror**

·         **emotional drama**

**━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━**

**🎭 CASTING ROLES**

**⭐ BAILEY — CASTING ASAP**

**Female, 20s**

**Bailey is a relaxed, playful, artistic young woman who is painting alone in the woods when Derek literally runs into her. She quickly becomes one of the more thoughtful characters Derek encounters. She listens to his bizarre explanations and doesn't completely believe him—but she finds the idea interesting.**

**🎥 IMPORTANT:**

**BAILEY'S SCENE WILL BE FILMED FIRST ON AUGUST 28TH.**

**You would not need to be there for the entire production day. Bailey's scene is specifically being scheduled first so we can get her portion completed before moving on to the rest of the film.**

**👦 CHRISTIAN (Lead Supporting)**
**Male, late teens–20s**
**Derek’s best friend. Funny, grounded, sarcastic, but secretly wants to belong too.**

**🌌 LAUREN**
**Female, late teens–20s**
**Quietly philosophical and thoughtful. Wonders about humanity, existence, and whether we matter in the grand scheme of the universe.**

**🌼 CARRIE**
**Female, late teens–20s**
**Lauren’s friend. More practical, funny, and grounded. Balances Lauren’s existential spirals with realism.**

**📚 DOUG**
**Male, 20s–40s**
**A perpetually annoyed guy just trying to read his book in peace while Derek accidentally ruins his day.**

**🚗 JENNY**
**Female, late teens–30s**
**Exhausted, anxious, and vulnerable. Lead role in a suspense/thriller segment involving a terrifying roadside encounter.**

**🔧 THE MAN**
**Male, 20s–40s**
**A charming but deeply unsettling stranger. Calm, polite, and dangerous. Horror/thriller role.**

**🩺 DOCTOR**
**Male or Female, 30s+**
**Deadpan comedic doctor with absurd confidence and detective-level diagnosis skills.**

**💉 NURSE**
**Female or Male, 20s+**
**Confused but earnest nurse caught in increasingly ridiculous medical logic.**

**📋 ANOTHER NURSE**
**Any Gender, 20s+**
**Brief but memorable comedic role.**

**💔 MARY**
**Female, late teens–20s**
**Strong-willed and emotionally intelligent. Wants independence in her relationship without constantly being “protected.”**

**🏃 BOBBY**
**Male, late teens–20s**
**Athletic, emotional, and protective. Means well but struggles to understand Mary’s perspective.**

**🎬 CAMERA MAN**
**Male or Female, any age**
**Aggressive, overworked indie film crew member trying to protect “the master shot” .**

**📢 DIRECTOR**
**Male or Female, any age**
**Short but memorable meta-comedy role. Treats Derek like a background extra.**

**SCHOOL EXTRAS**
**All genders, 18+ preferred**
**Students, audience members, background actors, crowds, etc.**

**━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━**

**📍 FILMING LOCATION:**
**Colorado Springs, Colorado**

**💵 COMPENSATION:**
**Unpaid**

**Includes:**
**🎥 IMDb Credit**
**📂 Copy of footage**
**🎭 Experience on an ambitious indie anthology project**

**━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━**

**📩 TO AUDITION / APPLY:**
**Email: ****[jjacks24@uccs.edu](mailto:jjacks24@uccs.edu)**

**Include:**
**• Name**
**• Age**
**• Recent photo/selfie**
**• Availability**

The Film Program at Cinematic Arts at CCA (formerly The Colorado Film School) invites actors of all ages to participate in our Fall 2026 Open Auditions!

Our student filmmakers are casting for a wide range of short films, narrative projects, and cinematic productions, and we are seeking performers of all backgrounds, ages, and experience levels to help bring these stories to life on screen.

Whether you are a seasoned professional, a student, or someone who simply loves acting, you are warmly invited to audition and collaborate with the next generation of filmmakers.

📅 Audition Dates & Times

Friday, September 4, 2026

🕙 10:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.

Saturday, September 5, 2026

🕙 10:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m.

 

📍 Location

Lowry Studios – Community College of Aurora

9075 E. Lowry Blvd.

Denver, CO 80230

 

🎭 What to Prepare

Please bring a 2–3 minute prepared monologue for your primary audition.

In addition to the main audition, we will also host Satellite Auditions for specific student film productions:

• These will take place in rooms throughout the building

• Auditions are first-come, first-served

• Actors can sign up to cold read for individual projects

• We anticipate up to 10 productions casting during this event

• A list of roles and productions will be available on the day of the audition

• Participation in satellite auditions is optional, but highly encouraged

 

📝 How to Sign Up

Actors can sign up using the QR code on the flyer or by visiting:

Accessible Web Link:

https://www.ccaurora.edu/open-auditions

(For visually impaired users or anyone unable to scan the QR code, this link provides full access to the sign-up form.)

If you can't find a reserved space that works for you, come anyway during your preferred time. We will work you into the schedule!

We can't wait to see you this Friday or Saturday!

 

📩 Questions?

Please contact:

galina.boulgakova@ccaurora.edu

 🎥 Help our students tell their stories through the magic of cinema.

Please share this opportunity with your talent networks, acting studios, schools, and community groups — we can’t do this without you!

 

Warmly,

Cinematic Arts Team

sharedPost.text:
Motion to recuse/remove Judge John Roach Jr.

‼️ Share Share Share

‼️ We Stand with Karmelo Anthony Show up with your white Tshirt on and be ready to Rally in Peace! Justice for Karmelo Anthony!

⚖️ Karmelo Anthony — August 19, 2026
Date: Wednesday, August 19, 2026
Time: 9:00 AM Central Time
Hearing: Motion to recuse/remove Judge John Roach Jr. from overseeing the post-conviction proceedings

Judge hearing the recusal motion: Senior Judge Sid Harle

Court: 494th District Court, Collin County
Location: Collin County Courthouse
Address: 2100 Bloomdale Road, McKinney, TX 75071
Phone: (972) 548-4100

The hearing is scheduled for 9:00 AM, and recent reporting says the proceedings are open to the public. There will also be an overflow room with live audio/video if the courtroom fills up. However, cameras are not permitted, so it is not expected to be livestreamed!

Because this is a high-profile hearing, I would not plan to arrive at 8:45 AM for a 9:00 AM hearing.

I'd recommend:

7:30–7:45 AM — Arrive at the courthouse

That gives you roughly 75–90 minutes for:

Parking
Walking to the entrance
Security screening
Finding the 494th Courtroom
Getting a seat

Collin County specifically advises visitors to arrive early enough to allow time for parking and courthouse security. The county says the courthouse doors can open as early as 7:00 AM.

🅿️ Parking

There is public parking available on the courthouse property.

Since you're going for the Karmelo Anthony hearing, I'd choose a parking area as close to the courthouse entrance as possible rather than assuming you'll be able to park immediately when you arrive.

🔐 Security

Treat it like going through airport-style security.

Don't bring:

Weapons
Knives or other blades
Pepper spray
Other prohibited items
Anything that could be considered a security concern

Collin County warns that prohibited items will not simply be held for you at the entrance, so leave questionable items in your vehicle rather than bringing them inside.

🏛️ Once you're inside

Tell courthouse personnel:

“I'm here for the Karmelo Anthony hearing in the 494th Courtroom.”

The official county notice specifically identifies 494th Courtroom, so you don't need to guess which courtroom you're looking for.

⭐ My recommendation for you

If you want to actually get inside the courtroom and have a good chance of getting a seat, I'd personally aim to be at the courthouse by 7:30 AM.

And because this is likely to draw substantial public interest, getting there early is much safer than arriving at 8:45 AM.

Courthouse: 2100 Bloomdale Road, McKinney, TX 75071
Hearing: 9:00 AM, August 19, 2026
Courtroom: 494th Courtroom
Main phone: (972) 548-4100

OFF TOPIC 

Pitching a movie is hard, 

But changing the narrative around the foster care system is harder.
 
🎬✨I am working on the development and prep work for my upcoming feature film, Finding Santa, with the goal of bringing this powerful story to the screen in 2027.

Right now, I need your help! I am conducting a quick audience research survey for my MFA Producing Marketing class. 

Your feedback will not just help me pass my homework assignment, it will directly shape the actual development and pitch strategy for the movie itself.

If you have a few minutes to support independent film and help me hit my class goals, please click the link below to share your thoughts!👇 

Take the Survey Here 👇

Thank you so much for the support! 🤍

CALLING ALL WRITERS! 

Growing Old Is Mandatory, Growing Up Is optional ❤️❤️

We are doing a Fundraiser in September to help raise funds to help buy an elderly lady a hearing aid and we are looking for  short scenes to put on the stage! 

🖋️Each piece has to be max 10mins 

🎭 Up to 4 characters per scene. 

🗓️Our theme for the night is growing old/life experiences. This could be that a story about growing up or a specific event in life, it is completely up to your interpretation. 

🎨 And we would ask that if you require props to have a minimal amount if possible as these will be short scenes with short turn around times! 

If you have a piece that you would be interested in putting on the stage to test it out or have any questions, give us an email at info@bletherstreetltd.org ! 

REMINDER: This opportunity is unpaid 

We look forward to hearing from you! 🍾

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd16rLQ6edtr3XbZRPRQhBokNivQ2_C69zMkhQIicLnC60OxA/viewform?usp=header

🎬 **CASTING CALL — FOUR FRIENDS | YORK / LEEDS**

Morning!

I’m looking to cast **a group of four friends**, aged **20–26**, for an** unpaid** lifestyle promo film project, for an ice cream brand due to be filming within the next two weeks (one day).

I’m ideally looking for a group with a **genuine friendship and natural chemistry** though happy to consider those who don't know each other! Personality, energy and authenticity are far more important.

**Location:** York / Leeds area

**Date: **TBC but within the next two week
**Casting:** 4 friends, aged 20–26
**Type of project:** Independent film project
**Payment:** Unpaid
**Expenses & food:** Provided, though only considering York/Leeds talent for this!

The shoot will be a relaxed, collaborative day and a great opportunity to get involved in a creative film project and have some fun along the way.

Please comment below or send me a DM with:
* Your name and playing age
* Where you're based
* Spotlight/Reel/Website

Or feel free to tag anyone who might be a good fit! 

(Pic for attention)

OPEN CASTING CALL for Mobile Operator Commercial – Pilot

All genders, ages 30-35+ (1 main role, 4 supporting roles)

**LOCATION:** Berlin, Germany (Mitte / Kreuzberg)

**COMPENSATION:** Paid 

**APPLY HERE ** https://forms.gle/hM34Wio3zVD3qukt6

**TIME:**
Submission **deadline: August 15, 23:59**
Shoot date: August 19 (weather-dependent)
Main role: Female, ~2 hrs on set
Supporting roles: Any gender, 30 min-1 hr on set

No acting experience required – natural presence and confidence on camera matter more than a reel. Open to all appearances, backgrounds, skin tones, and body types. English spoken on set, German spoken on camera. Bonus if you have a bike and don't mind riding it in a scene. 

Questions? Reach out to casting manager Sasha at 015781294185a@gmail.com

items.text:
CASTING CALL – Children – Non-Speaking Product Video - Paid

I'm casting for a non-speaking product video featuring creative building toys similar to LEGO-style construction sets. Non-union.

I'm looking for the following roles:

Role 1 - Female, Age 7-12, Black ethnicity

Role 2 - Male, Age 5-8, Black ethnicity

Ideal Candidates
* Outgoing, confident personalities who enjoy playing with toys
* Able to follow simple direction and stay engaged during filming
* Comfortable in front of the camera
* Previous modeling or acting experience is welcome, but not required
* Siblings or friends would be preferred but not required.

Project Details
* Non-speaking role
* Small-scale, two-person production team in a relaxed, low-stress environment
* The two children will likely be needed for 1–2 hours, though filming may extend up to 4 hours

Pay: $50 CAD/hour (3-hour minimum guaranteed) — Minimum booking of $150 per child

A fun opportunity to earn some extra money, gain on-camera experience, and try something new during summer break!

Filming Schedule

Dates: TBD (sometime in within the next two weeks)

Location: Lower Mainland, BC (exact location TBD, likely surrey or White Rock)

I'm currently building my talent roster and will work around everyone's availability when scheduling filming.

Usage

The finished videos will be published digitally across the client's Amazon listings, website,brand store, social media channels, and other online advertising platforms.

Important Note

Per my client's request and for confidentiality purposes, the finished videos cannot be released to the talent or used for personal portfolios or demo reels.

Parent/Guardian Requirement

A parent or legal guardian must remain on set for the duration of filming for all child participants.

Interested?

Please email the following to runestonepics@gmail.com :
* Child's name, age, and gender
* A few recent photos (phone photos are perfectly fine)
* General availability over the summer
* Any previous modeling or acting experience (optional)

Subject Line: Child Casting Role # – (Age, Gender)

Example: Child Casting Role #1 – 10, Female

Selected applicants will be contacted with additional project details, filming dates, and a model release form.

I look forward to hearing from you

Für einen Trailer im Stil von Quentin Tarantino suchen wir eine junge Schauspielerin im Spielalter von ca. 20 bis 29 Jahren.

Rollenprofil:
Du spielst eine Kassiererin, die zunächst unscheinbar und unschuldig wirkt. Gesucht wird ein zierlicher, sehr natürlicher Typ, gerne mit dem Look eines sympathischen „Mädchens vom Land“. Kein auffälliges Make up, keine glamouröse Erscheinung. Natürlichkeit ist uns wichtig.

Die Rolle beinhaltet Dialog und endet in einer inszenierten Erschießungsszene. Die entsprechenden Effekte werden selbstverständlich filmisch umgesetzt.

Drehort: Nordhorn
Drehzeitraum: voraussichtlich Ende August 2026
Drehumfang: 2 Drehtage
Gage: No Budget, keine Gage
Fahrt und Übernachtungskosten: können leider nicht übernommen werden
Verpflegung: Für Verpflegung am Set wird selbstverständlich gesorgt.

Daher suchen wir bevorzugt Schauspielerinnen aus Nordhorn und Umgebung.

Der Trailer ist Teil eines eigenständigen Filmprojekts und soll einen markanten, schwarzhumorigen Action und Crime Stil bekommen.

Bei Interesse schick uns bitte eine kurze Vorstellung sowie aktuelle Fotos und, falls vorhanden, einen Link zu deinem Showreel oder Schauspielprofil an:

📧 a.artur@gmx.net

Wir freuen uns auf eure Bewerbungen! 🎬

Du spielst eine Kassiererin, die zunächst unscheinbar und unschuldig wirkt. Gesucht wird ein zierlicher, sehr natürlicher Typ, gerne mit dem Look eines sympathischen „Mädchens vom Land“. Kein auffälliges Make up, keine glamouröse Erscheinung. Natürlichkeit ist uns wichtig.

Die Rolle beinhaltet Dialog und endet in einer inszenierten Erschießungsszene. Die entsprechenden Effekte werden selbstverständlich filmisch umgesetzt.

Drehort: Nordhorn
Drehzeitraum: voraussichtlich Ende August 2026
Drehumfang: 2 Drehtage
Gage: No Budget, keine Gage
Fahrt und Übernachtungskosten: können leider nicht übernommen werden
Verpflegung: Für Verpflegung am Set wird selbstverständlich gesorgt.

Daher suchen wir bevorzugt Schauspielerinnen aus Nordhorn und Umgebung.

Der Trailer ist Teil eines eigenständigen Filmprojekts und soll einen markanten, schwarzhumorigen Action und Crime Stil bekommen.

Bei Interesse schick uns bitte eine kurze Vorstellung sowie aktuelle Fotos und, falls vorhanden, einen Link zu deinem Showreel oder Schauspielprofil an:

📧 a.artur@gmx.net

Wir freuen uns auf eure Bewerbungen! 🎬

1. Create instead of waiting. Publish your work, develop your skills and make your own opportunities.

3. Build a recognizable profile. Consistency, reliability and authentic presence make you harder to overlook. 

MY WORK 

I’m Christian Weiße, Actor, Content Creator ( Karrideo Imagefilm-Produktion ) , Moderator, Interviewer and Film Producer. I work across film, TV, streaming, social media, interviews and commercial productions, combining experience in front of and behind the camera.

items.summary:
THREE WAYS TO MOVE FORWARD 

1. Create instead of waiting. Publish your work, develop your skills and make your own opportunities. 

2. Invest in people who reciprocate. Professional and personal relationships should never depend on constant chasing. 

3. Build a recognizable profile. Consistency, reliability and authentic presence make you harder to overlook. 

MY WORK 

I’m Christian Weiße, Actor, Content Creator ( Karrideo Imagefilm-Produktion ) , Moderator, Interviewer and Film Producer. I work across film, TV, streaming, social media, interviews and commercial productions, combining experience in front of and behind the camera. 

Casting, productions and collaborations: 

christian.weisse.talent@gmail.com 

Stop measuring your value by somebody else’s attention. Focus on yourself and what you can create next. 

#ChristianWeiße #Actor #ContentCreator #FilmProduction #Mindset

Nicolay Bein

​Sie​

**🎬 Schauspieler | Kleindarsteller | Komparse aus Hamburg sucht neue Projekte**

**Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,**

mein Name ist **Nicolay Bein**, ich bin 41 Jahre alt, 1,94 m groß und lebe in Hamburg.

Aktuell bin ich auf der Suche nach **seriösen Film- und TV-Produktionen sowie neuen Möglichkeiten als Schauspieler, Kleindarsteller oder Komparse**. Besonders interessiere ich mich für Filme, Serien, Werbespots, Musikvideos, Imagefilme und weitere spannende Projekte.

Ich stehe noch **am Anfang meiner schauspielerischen Laufbahn** und möchte meine Erfahrungen vor der Kamera kontinuierlich erweitern, mich weiterentwickeln und weitere Einblicke in die Film- und Medienbranche gewinnen.

Erste Erfahrungen konnte ich bereits **als Komparse bei einem Filmdreh** sammeln. Die Arbeit am Set hat mir sehr viel Freude bereitet und meinen Wunsch bestärkt, künftig regelmäßig vor der Kamera zu stehen.

Ich bin **zuverlässig, pünktlich, motiviert, lernbereit und teamfähig**. Gleichzeitig bin ich offen für unterschiedliche Rollen und Aufgaben und freue mich darauf, mich auf neue Projekte und Herausforderungen einzulassen.

Ich stehe sowohl für **einzelne Drehtage als auch für längerfristige Projekte** zur Verfügung. Anfragen aus **Hamburg und dem gesamten Bundesgebiet** sind herzlich willkommen.

📩 Bei Interesse freue ich mich sehr über Ihre Kontaktaufnahme. Gerne sende ich Ihnen **aktuelle Fotos, meine Vita und weitere Informationen** zu.

Ich freue mich darauf, interessante Projekte kennenzulernen, weitere Erfahrungen zu sammeln und neue Kontakte in der Film- und Medienbranche zu knüpfen.

**Mit freundlichen Grüßen**

HOW TO SPOT A GENUINE CASTING CALL

We know how exciting it can be when you see a casting call that feels like the perfect opportunity.

 now a days Casting directors do post genuine casting calls on Facebook, Instagram and other social media platforms. But before you submit, just take a few minutes to check.

CHECK THE CASTING DIRECTOR

Have a look at their website, previous work and professional background. Many genuine casting directors also have dedicated casting call pages on their websites, so check there too.

CHECK THE CONTACT DETAILS

Make sure the social media account, email address and submission link are genuine and connected to the casting director or production company.

NEVER PAY TO AUDITION

Most importantly, never pay simply to audition or be considered for a role. Genuine casting directors are looking for talent and are paid by the production or client to find the right people.

WHEN IN DOUBT, CHECK

If something doesn't feel right, take a moment to investigate. There is absolutely nothing wrong with asking questions. It is always better to check than to take a risk.

At Mark Summers Casting, we always encourage talent to stay safe, check who they are dealing with and never be afraid to ask questions.

Please share this with your fellow performers. It might just help someone avoid a scam.

#CastingCall #Casting #CastingDirector #Actors #Performers #Acting #Talent #FilmCasting #CommercialCasting #Auditions #CastingScam #ScamAwareness #StaySafe #ActorSafety #CastingTips #EntertainmentIndustry #FilmIndustry #ActingCommunity #MarkSummersCasting
